name: android_record_screen
description: Records the screen to MP4 for durationSec seconds (default 5, max 180) and saves it on the computer at localDestination.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

durationSec.description: Duration of the recording in seconds (default 5, max 180).

localDestination.description: Absolute destination path on the computer (e.g. /tmp/recording.mp4).
